---
name: commit-style
description: Write commit messages as Conventional Commits, with a type, an optional scope and an imperative summary under 72 characters.
---

# Commit style

1. Pick the type: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `test`, `refactor`, `chore` or `ci`.
2. Write `<type>(<scope>): <summary>` with the summary in the imperative mood.
3. Explain why in the body, wrapped at 72 characters.
